detail: TITAN meets Buffett-Jhunjhunwala quality criteria with none moat and ROCE avg 23.5%. Business quality score 70/100 reflects moderate conviction based on 10-year financial history and DCF-derived margin of safety.
key_risks: Current price offers limited margin of safety at DCF-implied value
Economic moat not clearly established or declining margins
ROCE below 15% suggests capital allocation inefficiency
Promoter pledging or declining holding raises governance concern
why_buffett_would_like: TITAN delivers ROCE of 23.5% with none moat characteristics and EPS CAGR of 18.1% — the kind of capital efficiency that compounds shareholder wealth over a decade.
why_buffett_would_pass: Even quality businesses at a DCF margin of safety of -92.1% carry re-rating risk — a patient Buffett-style investor would want the 70/100 business quality score sustained through the next cycle before committing full capital.
